answer.reason: Two narratives place events at En-rogel: the messengers waiting there for David, and Adonijah's feast, while the boundary verses only mark a border.

clauses.english: was where Jonathan and Ahimaaz waited to carry word to King David
clauses.quote: Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel

clauses.english: was where Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and called his brethren to a feast
clauses.quote: Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by Enrogel

doubts: JOS 15:7 and JOS 18:16-17 only mark the boundary line, so they are not used.
